summary: This bill amends the Social Security Act to eliminate cost-sharing for diagnostic and supplemental breast examinations under Medicaid and to include screening mammography as a mandatory benefit.

scores.thoughts: This bill expands Medicaid coverage to include no-cost diagnostic and supplemental breast examinations and screening mammography. By making these services more accessible through a public healthcare program, it moves towards more public healthcare.

The bill expands benefits under Medicaid, a key social safety net program, by requiring no-cost breast examinations. This directly increases the scope of welfare services provided to eligible individuals.
